title: Do older households spend more per person in the EU?
subtitle: EU households headed by someone aged 60 or over spent 35.1% more per person than those headed by someone under 45 in 2020, up from 34.2% more in 2015.
textNote: Households are grouped by the age of their reference person. Spending per person includes all household members. Positive values mean older households spent more per person than younger households in the same country. Negative values mean they spent less
